_meta.what: Cards that are not in the game yet, in the owner's sheet order. They are dealt into no deck and show in no collection.
_meta.fields: As data/cards.json, with the same stone colors (yellow->mind, blue->space, orange->soul, red->reality, purple->power), plus "status": where the card's art stands, from the owner's sheet; absent means not started.
_meta.ids: A card that was once in the game keeps its id and image here, so saved games that hold it still play back. A card that never shipped has neither until it enters cards.json, where it takes the next number in its level; a card sold in a pack is listed in data/packs.json as well.
